narrative: He is Gaunt on the public stage. The house is a Friday house. The roll is the cut book. In the margin, still dry, the line that was already there. He does not send for a glass. The glass is broken, and this yard does not get the pieces. The death of Gaunt is in this book, and the parliament is not. He gives the old line to a yard, not to a chair three yards off. No one is dashed anything on these boards. Burbage's king, when he comes, will not unmake himself here. Between the acts the three leaves are not on the trestle. The chest is not open. Tuesday's floor is not this stage. He does not announce the difference. The margin does it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played the cut Gaunt, and did not open the leaves.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Played the king this book allows, and did not give the crown away.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on part in Not in this roll
